messages:
alex_chen: Hey team — we need to request GPU quota increases in eu-north-3 for a new tenant (Nimbus). Need p5, p4d and g5 capacity and some network limits bumped. Blocker for onboarding; target start in ~2 weeks.

maria_gonzalez: Which AWS account ID and exact counts? Also are we targeting Hosted or Dedicated for this tenant?

alex_chen: Account: 123456789012 (Nimbus-prod). Region: eu-north-3 only initially. Steady-state: p5=2, p4d=1, g5=4. Burst buffer: x2 for first 4 weeks (so request p5=4, p4d=2, g5=8). This is for hosted inference but we may move some capacity to Dedicated later.

cheng_li: I can open the Service Quotas support case. FYI also need to request ENI and related networking limits (ENIs per region, IPs per ENI, EIP count). Quick aws-cli check you can run: 

`aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A --region eu-north-3`

That returns current limits for the quota code; we usually ask for the per-instance-family running instance limits and explicit instance-type counts.

maria_gonzalez: Good call. Please ask for ENI and VPC-level IP limits up-front. We hit that in the last APAC onboarding.

ivy-infra-bot: Preflight check: account 123456789012 missing "eni-capacity-uplift" label and no existing Dedicated reservation. Internal ticket INFRA-3421 created to track network limit changes and cross-account VPC peering if needed.

sre-oncall: Are you planning multi-AZ placement groups or single-AZ placement? p4d often needs special handling (placement groups + networking). Also ensure we have AMIs with required drivers uploaded to the account.

alex_chen: Single-AZ to start. We'll request multi-AZ if aws asks. AMIs already in our central account; will share AMI IDs and grant launch permissions.

cheng_li: Drafting the AWS Service Quotas / Support case. Use this template — copy/paste into the AWS console case: 

```
Subject: Request GPU instance and network quota increases in eu-north-3 for account 123456789012

Hello AWS Service Quotas team,

We are requesting quota increases for the following resources in eu-north-3 for AWS account 123456789012 (Redwood - Nimbus):

- EC2 On-Demand p5 instances (p5.24xlarge): current 0 -> request 4
- EC2 On-Demand p4d instances (p4d.24xlarge): current 0 -> request 2
- EC2 On-Demand g5 instances (g5.12xlarge / g5.48xlarge mix): current 0 -> request 8
- Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs): current 50 -> request 200
- IPv4 addresses per ENI: current 2 -> request 4
- VPC Elastic IPs: current 5 -> request 20

Justification: Launching production inference tenants that require dedicated GPU capacity for regulated customers. Production traffic expected 24/7 with predictable bursts during onboarding. We are happy to provide expected monthly GPU-hours and billing justification.

Requested by: Alex Chen (infra team), infra@redwood.ai

Thanks,
Redwood Inference
```

cheng_li: Marked it Business-critical and submitted. Case ID: 2345678901. :rocket:

maria_gonzalez: Nice. Can you also add a short paragraph on tenancy/ebs-optimized needs and attach expected monthly GPU hours (approx)? AWS asks that to prioritize.

alex_chen: Added numbers and note about default tenancy + EBS optimization. I also pinged Commercial to confirm potential reserved pricing (we may sign reserved capacity if AWS asks).

ivy-infra-bot: INFRA-3421 updated with AWS case ID 2345678901 and an estimated follow-up workflow: validate AMI permissions, ensure SG rules for private endpoints, confirm VPCs are sized for /20 scale.

cheng_li: AWS replied asking for the expected sustained GPU-hours and what we're using the GPUs for. I added: "Sustained approx 3,600 GPU-hours/month per p5, primarily inference for enterprise customers (PII-safe workloads)." Asked for a 3-5 business day review.

sre-oncall: Thanks — once quotas land, I'll coordinate placement groups and network performance tests. Also confirm limits on ENI attachment to instances of those families (some instance types have higher ENI counts).

maria_gonzalez: Action items recap: Cheng opens case (done), Alex adds billing justification (done), Ivy creates INFRA ticket (done), SRE will validate placement/AMIs after quota approval. ETA: follow-up in 72h or when AWS responds.

alex_chen: Appreciate the quick turnaround. If AWS asks to reduce initial ask we can drop p4d from 2->1 to speed approval. Will update here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
